text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Summer Walk. I ran into 
Tosen Jordan while shopping and ended up 
having to carry her bags—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Since the dress has a pink base, gold 
accessories would be super cute~! Ah, 
match the toe ring with sandals too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, really! Just doing things the 
usual way is totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but we're on the Summer Walk! Don't 
you think it's fun to show a different 
side of yourself sometimes~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That one-piece dress is way too cute, 
though... I-It definitely wouldn't look 
good on me! For sure!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way, no way... wait, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice encounter! You agree that vacations 
are all about adventure, right Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But still, Ryan-san, you're feeling 
iffy about it, aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wearing clothes that don't suit me 
feels kind of bad for the clothes, or 
rather, I'm just scared I'll stick out 
like a sore thumb—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that totally out of character?" 
"Wouldn't it be better not to push 
yourself?" kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! It just doesn't feel like 
myself, or rather...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda curious, but... is it really 
okay for me to buy it? Like...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I just couldn't imagine it actually 
belonging to me...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I get it...! I totally, totally get it!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? But you're curious, yet too shy to 
wear it yourself... I mean—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, you actually want to wear it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Well, no, that's...!
choice_data_list:
If you want to wear it, go ahead and try 
it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait. I really don't think that 
kind of thing is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I think outfits like that only look 
good on cute girls, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah...! A crazy girl who'd totally rock 
it, huh? Yeah, there's someone like that. 
There is, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, I get it. But like, how do I put 
this... Whenever I buy a new one-piece 
dress—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It hit me right away, like, 'Pink is so 
cute!'

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, looking at it, I kinda feel like 
it's not very me... Is it too sweet? Too 
cute, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, I don't wanna wear something totally 
not my vibe and stick out like a sore 
thumb... So I super get how Ryan-san 
feels.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, my pals gave me that push 
forward, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know how it looks to everyone 
else, and maybe it'd suit another girl 
better, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I put it on, took a picture, and thought, 
'Hey, I actually look pretty cute!'... 
That's why!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna think I'm cute, y'know? Being 
able to love yourself is the absolute 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So... let's take on the challenge! You 
too, Ryan-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I agree with Jordan. I think going on an 
adventure just to make yourself happy is 
super important.
choice_data_list: Why don't you just try it on?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Yeah. To learn to love myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it a try, this adventure...! 
First, I'll... try it on!

text_block_list.name: Jordan & Palmer
text_block_list.text: I did iiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go find some faves! Take 
tons of selfies during the Summer Walk, 
m'kay~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Wait, what!? It's already 
decided that we're buying it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when you want to do something, you 
might just need a little push with the 
right words. That's what this incident 
made me realize.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, time to try it on 
right away~! Ah, can I pick out the 
accessories too!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, hold on! I need to mentally 
prepare myself first...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three headed merrily toward the 
fitting rooms. After a short while, 
carrying shopping bags, they left the shop 
behind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Jordan. Let me thank you too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmm, well... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan smiled bashfully. I silently 
applauded her for stepping up to empathize 
with and support her friend.
